 <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3735">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3735">ka ma la shi la</rs></note> ni khyod kyi bstan bcos 'di brtsaM par bya ba ma yin ste | dgos pa myed pa'i phyir bya <lb edRef="inst:4454" n="47a3"/> rog gi so brtags pa'i bstan bcos bzhin no zhes | <note type="gloss">bstan chos rtsoM pa °° dgos pa yod pas khyab pa las khyab byed dgos pa med pas des rtsoM pa la don <abbr>med</abbr> ces bstan chos rtsoM pa'i</note> khyab byed myi dmyigs pa ltar 'chos pa'i rtags la brten nas bstan bcos rtsom pa'i skabs 'gog pa'i ngag gam log rtogs <!--Ar chos skor (ID:6286): 329--> phyir zlog pa'i ched du yin zer pa yang yod do || </seg></TEI>
